title: Baby Larry in Highchair with Betty at Home, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square black-and-white home snapshot capturing a baby, identified by the top margin inscription as Larry, sitting in a wooden highchair or combination play table. Resting on the surface are a tiny doll and a stuffed houndstooth-patterned puppy. To the right, a young mother, Betty, sits relaxed in an upholstered armchair wearing a short-sleeved plaid blouse. The mid-century living room interior features a floor lamp, a framed picture on the wall, and a doorway looking into an adjacent room.
